title: Import from other AI tools
hint: Copies MCP servers, rules, skills, agents and commands from another AI tool's config into Puppeteer's libraries. Pick the tool and where to read it, then tick what to import.
remote: Import reads the AI tool configs of the computer running Puppeteer, so it only works in the app on that computer, not from a remote desktop.
noSources: No AI tool config with something to import was found in your home folder or in any project.
problems: {count} item(s) could not be read and were left out:
name: Name in the library
copyOnly: Files are copied; the tool's own config is not changed.

conflict.duplicate: Same name as an item above
